name: Poxbringer

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: The Poxbringer may use Ruin actions and has 2 personal Ruin.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this threat must make a DN 4 Fear Test

abilities.name: Maleficarum
abilities.text: The Poxbringer attempts to activate a psychic power including Smite or a Maleficarum psychic power, treat Corruption as 5.

abilities.name: Cheerful Contagion
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. Another model in the conflict with the NURGLE or Mark of NURGLE keyword regains 2 Wounds.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 9d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: Battlecry printed without a final full stop. Cheerful Contagion's RUIN label is printed in plain (not bold) type.
